concerns.text: Verify that generated DOCX MIME headers and UTF-8 Content-Disposition filenames remain consistent across mobile and desktop clients.
Ensure test coverage includes boundary cases for the session period (25.01-25.02) across all specified academic groups.
Ensure institutional PIN verification endpoint has rate limiting and brute-force protection to prevent credential enumeration.
Verify session token invalidation behavior on client-side logout or timeout.
Ensure client handles 404 or missing file responses gracefully when users initiate direct download for unlinked legacy catalog records.
Verify performance and rendering latency when searching and filtering the full corpus of 1,697 documents.
